In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the endotoxic activity of rough Brucella organisms is due to lipopolysac-charide.
the endotoxins of the rough organisms are identical to those of the smooth strains.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the endotoxin of the smooth species is the lipopolysac-charide, and the endotoxin in the rough organisms is a protein or glycoprotein.
the endotoxins of Brucella are similar to each other, but different from the endotoxns of Salmonella, Shigella, Escherichia and Klebsiella.
the endotoxins of Brucella are not unique and that the endotoxin of B. abortus is similar, if not identical, to that of B. ovi.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the endotoxin of the rough Brucella is not different from the endotoxin found in other gram-negative bacteria.
the rough Brucella species are not endotoxin-free and should be handled as potential pathogens.
